goal_intent: book Friday for two, then correct the time when you hear it read back wrong

turns.utterance: Hi there! I'm calling to book a table for a little get-together this Friday—my friend and I are catching up after ages. Is Friday available?
It’s just the two of us—nice and cosy! We were hoping for a table at 7pm, if that works.
Oh, actually, let’s make that eight o’clock instead! We realised we’d like a bit more time before dinner.
Sure, it's Iwan Prosser. Thanks for sorting that—my friend will be thrilled we got the later slot!
No, that's perfect! Thanks so much for your help, and have a great rest of your day. [END OF CALL]
